brand_identity.name: FakturaFlow
brand_identity.vibe: Modern, premium, fast, minimalist, inspired by Stripe, Notion, Linear, Vercel

mono.usage: Invoice numbers, monetary values, data tables

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: The 'Control Room' Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6 for dense data correlation.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Generous spacing inside structural containers: p-6 to p-8.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Subtle roundness: max 8px (rounded-lg) for outer cards, rounded-md for inner elements like inputs and buttons.
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-border), avoiding deep shadows. Use shadow-sm exclusively on hover or for active states. 'Linear' aesthetic.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Fixed width 256px (w-64), solid background, subtle right border, featuring navigation items with explicit hover states.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Slight vertical lift (-translate-y-[2px]) and shadow-md for interactive cards. Text colors must explicitly shift on hover (e.g., hover:text-primary).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle opacity and translate-y fade in for main content areas.

components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Never use native raw inputs for complex UI.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn Table with horizontal scroll, sticky headers, and subtle row hover backgrounds.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts via Shadcn Charts for Monthly Revenue/Expenses (Ingresos y Gastos) using area and bar charts.

key_views_and_features.auth: Clean split screen or centered modal with the logo, email/password login, and register toggle.
key_views_and_features.dashboard: KPI cards top row (Ingresos, Gastos, Beneficio, IVA, Facturas Pendientes). Middle row: Area chart for cashflow. Bottom: Recent invoices table.
key_views_and_features.invoices_facturas: List view with status badges (Pagada: Green, Pendiente: Amber, Vencida: Red). Editor view: Multi-line inputs with dynamic totals, IVA/IRPF calculation, and PDF export trigger.
key_views_and_features.clients_clientes: CRM-style list or grid displaying client details and associated revenue.
key_views_and_features.expenses_gastos: List with receipt thumbnail/icon, OCR upload trigger, supplier, amount, and category.
key_views_and_features.reports_reportes: Quarterly and annual fiscal reports with data visualization.
key_views_and_features.fiscal_calendar_calendario: Timeline or grid view for Modelos 303, 130, 111 with deadlines and visual statuses.
key_views_and_features.settings_configuracion: Tabs for Datos Fiscales, Logo, Series, Impuestos, Firma.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards against backgrounds, especially in dark mode.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='new-invoice-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply the modern Stripe/Linear aesthetic with 1px borders, subtle glass/neumorphic touches, and minimal clutter.
Ensure complete Spanish localization across all UI elements, labels, and placeholders.
Implement light and dark themes using Tailwind classes.
Follow the 'Control Room' grid layout for the dashboard to maximize data density efficiently.
Implement smooth, non-intrusive micro-interactions for buttons and list items.
DO NOT use generic Inter font. Use Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text. Load these from Google Fonts.
Use JetBrains Mono for monetary values and invoice numbers to ensure tabular alignment.
Implement components in .js and .jsx files as requested by the environment, NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Use the provided logo URL for the brand identity.
